title: Metrics, traces and observability backends: an overview

videos.script: metrics-server keeps one sample. Events last an hour. Logs live on the node until the pod is gone. {{short}} Every tool in this course so far answers what is happening now. A monitoring system answers what happened, and that is the question an incident asks. {{history}} It is built from three signals: metrics, logs and traces. {{three}} You will read what the cluster already exposes for a monitoring system to collect, find where the logs physically are, and see what the shop does not expose, which is the part that has to be written into the application itself. {{plan}}
